entities.name: Louis XIV
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: King of France (1643–1715), the "Sun King," who personified absolute monarchy. His 72-year reign was the longest in European history. He built Versailles, waged numerous wars, revoked the Edict of Nantes, and made France the dominant European power.
